description: The developer's team: the Championship final against Apollomon, Dianamon and Machinedramon with stats far above the game's own. The final of the Championship has a pool of one team, record 98 ("Death & Laws": Apollomon, SkullGreymon, GigaSeadramon), copied at boot into the pool (make_guide.py). Its members are records 294-296 of the member table (0x020E5564, 0x44 bytes each), used by no other team. A member is {+0x00 species, +0x08 nickname (UTF-16), +0x10 HP rank (unused), +0x14..+0x24 TP, Atk, Def, Wis, Spd ranks, +0x28..+0x38 five more ranks (column 6 of the stat curves), +0x3D, +0x3E}. A rank is a row (0-26) of the stat curves at 0x020CA60C; the HP comes from the species' own rank.
